message: KGSL snapshot parsed, materialized as SQL, summarized by SQL, and expert detail JSON indexed.

evidenceRequests.reason: Bind the exact snapshot capture, not onset/upload/current-device time.
evidenceRequests.suggestedSource: same-occurrence capture metadata, boot log and snapshot timestamp

evidenceRequests.reason: Fill only unresolved KGSL CTX/ptbase to incident PID/package bindings; never use logger PID, truncated fence number or PowerEvents package label. Captured ring CTX candidates: 3, 8, 21.
evidenceRequests.suggestedSource: explicit KGSL ctx/pid/ptbase line plus same-window process inventory

evidenceRequests.reason: Supply logged IB base/size/pipe/context with its own capture window; missing IB bytes still require a captured payload.
evidenceRequests.suggestedSource: KGSL fault block / CP_IB register log / explicitly bound UMD submit

evidenceRequests.reason: Supplement unresolved ring/context observations with explicit ring VA and context; a raw ring ID alone is not a stable ring key.
evidenceRequests.suggestedSource: same-window KGSL ring/context submit or fault log

evidenceRequests.reason: Supply descriptor/resource fields only when explicitly logged; allocation size is not image dimensions.
evidenceRequests.suggestedSource: same-incident UMD resource log or descriptor dump

evidenceRequests.reason: Keep logged ROM/KMD/UMD identity separate from independently verified source mapping.
evidenceRequests.suggestedSource: stabd build metadata, exact module Build-ID or version inventory

suggestedQueries.name: Supplemental log evidence
suggestedQueries.purpose: Hash/excerpt-verified external claims with scope and native-identity conflict checks; never a replacement for snapshot-native evidence.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_log_context_bindings ORDER BY observation_id LIMIT 100;

suggestedQueries.name: Log evidence coverage
suggestedQueries.purpose: All kinds of imported log observations, including rejected scope and non-context target details.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM log_observations ORDER BY observation_id LIMIT 100;

suggestedQueries.name: Snapshot target identity
suggestedQueries.purpose: Captured target identity and the semantic decoding profile; caller-supplied build/source IDs are not independently verified.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_snapshot_target;

suggestedQueries.name: Ring context composition
suggestedQueries.purpose: All context slot candidates grouped separately by pending, historical, and unavailable window; a ring need not have a single owner.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_ring_context_backlog ORDER BY rb_section_index,in_unconsumed_window DESC,first_forward_dword;

suggestedQueries.name: Fetched IB context candidates
suggestedQueries.purpose: An exact CP IB1 base/initial-size match can locate an already-fetched RB call before rptr whose next EOP remains pending; this is non-atomic candidate evidence.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT m.*,c.context_id,c.timestamp,c.attribution_status FROM rb_cursor_matches m LEFT JOIN rb_ib_context_candidates c USING(rb_candidate_index);

suggestedQueries.name: Command composition
suggestedQueries.purpose: Bounded IB/GPU_OBJECT reconstruction with context neighbors, ptbase gates, aliases and missing payloads. Context is a candidate, not PID proof.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_command_streams ORDER BY in_unconsumed_window DESC,root_stream_id,stream_id LIMIT 100;

suggestedQueries.name: PM4 resource targets
suggestedQueries.purpose: Explicit register or memory operand targets, source packet, captured base and allocation details; full image extent and active attachment are unproven.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM pm4_targets ORDER BY stream_id,packet_index LIMIT 100;

suggestedQueries.name: PM4 translations
suggestedQueries.purpose: Exact file/GPU offsets, raw operands and command meaning. Filter stream_id or use v_context_pm4 for a context candidate.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM pm4_packets ORDER BY packet_index LIMIT 50;

suggestedQueries.name: Ramdump incident context binding
suggestedQueries.purpose: Cross-check digest-verified ramdump kern.log PID/context/timestamp evidence with the independently inferred EVENTLOG context. An empty result means no ramdump binding was supplied.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_incident_context_binding ORDER BY context_index;

suggestedQueries.name: Context backlog
suggestedQueries.purpose: Show OS timestamp triples with only unique score>=2 EVENTLOG context inference and any imported ramdump incident context comparison.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_context_backlog ORDER BY context_index;

suggestedQueries.name: RB to IB candidates
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect CP_INDIRECT_BUFFER candidates in the real preemption-record unconsumed window first; unavailable hwsched pointers remain NULL.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_rb_ib_candidates ORDER BY in_unconsumed_window DESC, delta_to_read_pointer, candidate_index LIMIT 100;

suggestedQueries.name: Ringbuffer pointer state
suggestedQueries.purpose: Preserve uninitialized hwsched RB_V2 wptr bytes but use only a unique in-range rbase-matched Gen8 CP preemption-record rptr/wptr.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_ringbuffer_state ORDER BY section_index;

suggestedQueries.name: Ring context markers
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect strict CP_EVENT_WRITE memstore markers and exact EVENTLOG/HFI timestamp joins; context IDs still require time-bounded process binding.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_ring_context_markers ORDER BY in_unconsumed_window DESC, rb_section_index, ring_index;

suggestedQueries.name: ROQ raw state
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect Gen8 CP_ROQ_AVAIL_RB/IB raw values without applying unverified Gen8 rptr compensation.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM roq_states ORDER BY pipe_id, mvc_section_index;

suggestedQueries.name: Live command cursor candidates
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect non-zero BR/BV/LPAC CP IB register candidates and their IB/MEMLIST containment without promoting them to an active PC.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_live_command_cursors ORDER BY pipe_id, ib_level;

suggestedQueries.name: Indexed register inventory
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inventory INDEXED_REGS_V2 blocks by source-backed Gen8.2 selector profile, pipe, slice, logical range, and value count.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_indexed_register_inventory ORDER BY section_index;

suggestedQueries.name: GPU object inventory
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect source-backed GPU_OBJECT_V2 headers, payload hashes, and MEMLIST containment without assuming execution.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_gpu_object_inventory ORDER BY object_index;

suggestedQueries.name: GMU memory inventory
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect source-backed GMU_MEMORY headers, payload hashes, and bounded printable-string probes.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM gmu_memory ORDER BY gmu_memory_index;

suggestedQueries.name: Firmware identity
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect source-backed DEBUG records including SQE/AQE/GMU versions and slice mask.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM debug_records ORDER BY section_index;

suggestedQueries.name: HFI queue state
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect HFI queue pointers and pending dwords; zero pending separates historical ring residue from live queue work.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM hfi_queues ORDER BY section_index, queue_index;

suggestedQueries.name: HFI timestamp retire history
suggestedQueries.purpose: Cross-check source-backed historical F2H_TS_RETIRE records with EVENTLOG contexts without treating them as pending.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT m.sequence_number, m.ring_index, r.* FROM hfi_timestamp_retires r JOIN hfi_messages m USING(message_index) ORDER BY m.sequence_number;

suggestedQueries.name: GMU trace packets
suggestedQueries.purpose: Inspect source-backed pending GMU trace packets such as preemption trigger/done.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM gmu_trace_packets ORDER BY packet_index;

suggestedQueries.name: Program allocation candidates
suggestedQueries.purpose: Review MVC-derived program bases and MEMLIST containment without treating them as active execution.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_program_allocations ORDER BY stage, base_address_hex;

suggestedQueries.name: L0 exact-byte matches
suggestedQueries.purpose: Summarize exact captured L0 line matches without claiming tag validity or active PC.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_l0_match_summary ORDER BY match_status;

suggestedQueries.name: Expert JSON inventory
suggestedQueries.purpose: List structure-level detail entities available to gpu.snapshot_detail.
suggestedQueries.sql: SELECT entity_type, COUNT(*) AS items FROM expert_details GROUP BY entity_type ORDER BY entity_type;

evidenceBoundaries: Snapshot sections are copied sequentially, not atomically. EVENTLOG records may postdate OS, register, shader, RB, or IB state in the same file.
faultcount and section order are capture metadata; neither is a snapshot ordinal nor proof that a packet executed.

On Gen8 hwsched, a full-ring RB_V2 header can carry zero placeholders. Candidate ranking uses a uniquely rbase-matched CP preemption record when available; an unavailable pointer is never silently treated as zero.
RB_V2 may contain a full circular-ring copy. CP_INDIRECT_BUFFER hits outside the preemption-record rptr..wptr window are retained as historical candidates, not promoted to unconsumed work.
CP_EVENT_WRITE memstore hits use strict Type7 header validation and packet-address validation. They bind ring content to a KGSL context slot, not directly to a PID or package.

Gen8 CP_ROQ_AVAIL_RB/IB values are exposed as raw state only. The available reference implementation applies RB_REM compensation to A6xx, not Gen8, so no ROQ adjustment is silently applied to the preemption-record rptr.
IB_V2 commonly captures a containing allocation. Match packet ranges by containment and page-table context; do not require equal base or size.
MVC-derived CP pipe IB register rows are capture-state candidates. Without target-build register mapping and wave evidence, they are not proof of the faulting packet or active PC.
MVC/SHADER hardware_context_id selects SP hardware state. It is not a KGSL context ID and must not be joined to EVENTLOG context_id.
An exact L0-to-instruction-bank byte match proves captured content only. SP_INST_TAG validity and active-wave PC remain unproven.
Private struct and register semantics remain target-build dependent until the incident msm_kgsl.ko Build-ID and matching source commit are verified.
HFI queue read_index==write_index proves no pending HFI dwords at capture. Decoded sequence-contiguous ring contents are historical residue and do not prove pending or active firmware work.

A ramdump incident binding imports PID/context/timestamp from a specific kern.log snapshot anchor only after manifest digest and carved artifact SHA-256 validation. The fields remain log inference, not snapshot-native ownership proof.
